# Vendored SIFEN XSDs

Unmodified official DNIT schemas for `siRecepDE_v150`, fetched 2026-09-23 via
`node scripts/refresh-xsd.ts --update` from `https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/`.

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `siRecepDE_v150.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/siRecepDE_v150.xsd |
| `DE_v150.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/DE_v150.xsd |
| `DE_Types_v150.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/DE_Types_v150.xsd |
| `Paises_v100.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/Paises_v100.xsd |
| `Departamentos_v141.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/Departamentos_v141.xsd |
| `Monedas_v150.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/Monedas_v150.xsd |
| `Unidades_Medida_v141.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/Unidades_Medida_v141.xsd |
| `xmldsig-core-schema.xsd` | https://ekuatia.set.gov.py/sifen/xsd/xmldsig-core-schema.xsd |

`checksums.json` is the authoritative file list, generated by the same command.
Re-run it with `--update` to refresh; `verify-vendor` fails the build on any drift.

## Geographic catalog (not an XSD)

`geo-catalog.json` is the DNIT geographic reference table (Tabla 2.1: departments, districts and
cities; neighbourhoods are left out), generated from the official workbook by
`node scripts/build-geo-catalog.ts <xlsx> --update`. It is sorted by code, one tuple per line, and its
sha256 is in `checksums.json` like the XSDs (`verify-vendor` checks it; `refresh-xsd --update` keeps it).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Page | https://www.dnit.gov.py/en/web/e-kuatia/tablas-y-codificaciones |
| File | `CÓDIGO DE REFERENCIA GEOGRAFICA_NOVIEMBRE_2025__.xlsx` (sheet "División Político-Administrativ", updated 03/Noviembre/2025; the sheet cites INE "código geográfico 2022" as its source) |
| URL | https://www.dnit.gov.py/documents/20123/420592/C%C3%93DIGO+DE+REFERENCIA+GEOGRAFICA_NOVIEMBRE_2025__.xlsx/baf35d49-b6d2-406b-de70-a1d9f63e9e32?t=1769521630085 |
| Downloaded | 2026-10-13, 469941 bytes |
| SHA-256 | `3918fc3517ce0b5ae883648b9316bbb2583c1b49e614d51d8b441dae978abc16` |
| MD5 | `0d817dee1a6a0c307a8fd25140c4f9be` |
| Size | 18 departments, 272 districts, 6766 cities |

The workbook is not committed (no explicit license, 460 KB); the script refuses any file whose SHA-256
differs from the one above. The "Checksum MD5" PDF on the same page (`80733BB1C4834C9C2ABBBF3C194D1566`,
file dated 2023) does not match this 2025 workbook, so it cannot be used to verify it.
